verdict.rationale: Canva's first-party docs describe several write-capable surfaces for agents. The official MCP server supports design generation and design editing, the REST APIs can create and sync designs and assets, and the Apps SDK can add elements to a user's design. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can create and edit designs reliably, plus detail on edit granularity (some tools such as resize are gated to Pro plans and above).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can create or modify designs programmatically — through a write-capable API, plugin surface, or MCP tools — not just read them

citations.quote: Create designs programmatically from text descriptions and specifications
Apply targeted modifications to existing designs through natural language commands
You can use the REST APIs to build web apps that create and sync assets, designs, comments, and more.
You can use the Apps SDK to create apps that import content into Canva, add elements to a user's design, automate common design tasks, and more.
The Canva MCP server enables AI assistants to seamlessly interact with Canva's design capabilities.
